placement.detail: Poultry enclosure/structure >=4 ft from abutting parcel property lines, no confinement enclosure in required front setback; building/fire code compliance separately mandatory.

max.section: Ashland Community Development FAQ, Are chickens allowed?
max.detail: Under 5,000 sq ft: up to five hens; above 5,000 sq ft: one hen per 1,000 sq ft up to 20. The FAQ does NOT expressly resolve exactly 5,000 sq ft or zone-specific exceptions.

roosters.section: Ashland Community Development FAQ, Are chickens allowed?
roosters.detail: Roosters prohibited within city.

placement.section: Ashland Community Development FAQ, Are chickens allowed? (AMC 18.2.5.040 referenced)
placement.detail: Keep chickens >=20 ft from neighboring dwellings and >=10 ft from adjoining property; coop/run construction subject to accessory building rules, and no free roaming.

max.section: Lake Oswego official FAQ: Chickens and Roosters
max.detail: City expressly states no local numerical restrictions on chickens; this does not negate applicable coop construction requirements, noise or county jurisdiction differences.

roosters.section: Lake Oswego official FAQ: Chickens and Roosters / noise enforcement
roosters.detail: City expressly says no city-specific rooster ban; rooster crowing may violate noise ordinance, and Clackamas County rules apply outside city limits.

roosters.section: Tigard Urban Livestock quick guide, Ordinance 22-09 (2022)
roosters.detail: Roosters older than three months prohibited; no categorical all-age ban inferred.

placement.section: Tigard Urban Livestock quick guide, coop and nighttime containment
placement.detail: Coops (not fenced runs or beehives) >=5 ft from ALL property lines; livestock enclosed in structures during non-daylight hours.

max.detail: Six adult poultry + six pigeons per parcel normally; up to ten adults with filed written consent of all qualifying nearby residence owners within 50 ft, and +1 poultry per additional 5,000 sq ft beyond 10,000 sq ft; inspect exact lot.

roosters.detail: Citywide rooster ownership/harboring violation under cross-referenced TMC §17.02.041.

permit.section: TMC §5.30.010(C), building-permit threshold
permit.detail: Chicken/animal enclosure >200 sq ft requires building permit. This is a STRUCTURE permit trigger, not a general chicken-keeping permit exemption.

placement.detail: Animal enclosure >=12 ft from nearest residence/dwelling/hotel/apartment/rooming house, behind main front wall and outside required side yard setback.

max.section: Kent Official FAQ: How many domesticated fowl may I keep?
max.detail: At least 5000 sq ft lot permits up to three fowl, plus one for each extra 1000 sq ft of lot area; fowl are separate from ordinary pet category.

roosters.section: Kent Official FAQ: rooster noise/nuisance clarification
roosters.detail: No separate categorical rooster ban stated in city FAQ, but audible crowing that violates city noise ordinance may be enforced. Not an automatic permission to cause nuisances.

placement.section: Kent Official FAQ: chicken coop/property line
placement.detail: Chicken coop at least 10 ft from property line; private covenant or property-specific code may add conditions.

max.section: Everett small livestock permit regulations §2(4)(c),(f) approved 2024-01-23
max.detail: <=10,000-sq-ft residential lot up to SIX chickens; 10,000-15,000 EIGHT; 15,000-35,000 TEN; >35,000 add one per 5,000 sq ft, subject to combined cap twelve small livestock per 10,000 sq ft and zone/property permit. The 10,000 / 15,000 exact boundary overlaps in the document; city confirmation needed.

permit.section: Everett Facility Licenses: Livestock or small livestock / fees / renewals (2023 zoning caveat)
permit.detail: Facility license required for six or more chickens/domestic fowl or ANY rooster; annual renewal and inspection, $50 small livestock fee listed. Government page has Dec 2023 non-ag-zoning livestock restrictions; do NOT infer hens/roosters permitted at any zoning parcel.

placement.detail: No coops in front yards or street-facing side on corner lots; animal enclosures/pens >=5 ft from adjacent PROPERTY lines and comply with potentially greater specific EMC Title 19 zoning/neighboring dwelling rules. Chicken housing 2-4 sq ft indoors and outdoor 5-10 sq ft per bird; structure permits independent.

max.detail: Up to five ducks or female chickens at ≤¼ acre; nine at quarter-to-acre; ten plus 1 per 1,000sqft above one acre until two acres. Overlap at exactly one acre requires clarification.

roosters.detail: Roosters, geese, peacocks and similar loud fowl forbidden.

permit.detail: Animal allowance does not resolve accessory structure/building and special parcel permits.

placement.detail: Enclosures ≥10ft from ALL lot lines and may not be placed within applicable setbacks.

max.section: Bellingham Code §7.12.060(A), current through Ordinance 2026-08-022
max.detail: City expressly permits enclosed domesticated fowl including chickens, subject to any prohibiting ordinances; section does NOT specify a numerical flock ceiling, so this claim is confined to that provision and not proof of unlimited hens.

max.section: Yakima Planning FAQ: What animals am I allowed to keep? / YMC pets
max.detail: Hobby pet classification permits up to four hen chickens; animal husbandry is separate land-use category.

roosters.section: Yakima Planning FAQ: Pets and backyard hen requirements
roosters.detail: No rooster under ordinary residential pet chicken classification.

placement.detail: Backyard-only enclosed/fenced hens, coops/tractors >=10 ft from any residence or property line and >=5 ft from other structures/decks.

max.detail: 2025 amended zone table is NR square-foot-tiered, unlike older city Chicken Husbandry page. NR bands overlap 5,500–5,999 sf (4 vs 6 hens); city must resolve. UR/RA-5 up to 10; other NR tiers as code. Not automatic property approval.

roosters.section: City of Redmond Chicken Husbandry: Raising Chickens in Redmond
roosters.detail: Roosters not permitted; standard program is for hens and pullets in qualifying single-family zones.

permit.section: Redmond Code §7.04.157(C), approved husbandry registration
permit.detail: Approved registration required before keeping birds, not merely optional. City-hosted registration application has no fee; separate accessory-structure/HOA permissions may be necessary.

placement.detail: Clean shelter >=15 feet from any property line, exceptionally >=5 ft from property line if adjacent to qualified church/school/park, easement >=10 ft, or 10-ft street/trail corridor; no front-yard coops. Max shelter 200 sq ft and 8 ft high, run <=6 ft high. Not universal 15 ft to all lot lines.

max.section: Houston City Code §§6-35, 6-39 (2014 revision)
max.detail: Ordinary §6-35 cap up to 30 of one enumerated species and 40 combined fowl/rabbits/guinea pigs on an enclosure of 65 x 125 feet or smaller; larger enclosure ratio adjustments. This does not supersede 100-ft neighboring-building rule or special medically justified seven-hen permit.

roosters.section: Houston City Code §6-38(a),(f)
roosters.detail: Roosters/male chickens generally prohibited from possession and sale in city, with express government/medical/education/research exceptions.

permit.section: Houston City Code §6-39(a)-(b), specialized medical-need hen permit
permit.detail: Separate revocable permit option for at most seven laying hens requires physician statement of serious medical need for unfertilized eggs, 100-ft separation, city inspection, sanitation. Not a routine universal backyard hen permit.

placement.detail: Outdoor fowl/coop >=100 ft from another's dwelling, school, hospital, church; distance measured from enclosure to specified structures, NOT from lot lines. Commercial/public exhibition exceptions and Building Code apply.

roosters.section: Dallas City Code §7-7.3(b)-(e), 7/2026 current
roosters.detail: General offense for owning a rooster on city premises, with express animal-production zoning, government, exhibition, research and slaughterhouse defenses; qualifying roosters still need enclosure >=20 ft from adjacent property lines, noise restrictions.

max.section: City ACS Permits & Fees > Did You Know?; current City Code contents §5-107
max.detail: Official city ACS page states up to 8 domestic fowl, with one rooster, plus a separate two-head livestock tier. The website mistakenly names §5-109; current Code index is §5-107.

roosters.section: City ACS Permits & Fees > Did You Know?; current Code §5-107 animal limits
roosters.detail: Official city ACS page states at most ONE rooster in the ordinary eight-domestic-fowl residential tier; excess permits and parcel restrictions separately apply.

permit.section: City ACS Permits & Fees > Residential Animal Permits and Livestock Permits
permit.detail: Excess Animal Permit required when seeking animal numbers beyond ordinary residential limits. This does not waive building/zoning/coop permits or guarantee excess animal approval.

max.detail: General §4-81 limits adult animals at one-lawful-dwelling property to ten, with separate conditions for other dwelling types; §4-185 does NOT grant unlimited backyard hens or a universal chicken-specific cap. Only hens under §4-185, agricultural uses treated separately.

roosters.section: Plano City Code §4-185(a)
roosters.detail: Only chicken hens permitted for ordinary backyard animal keeping; roosters and any other fowl prohibited (legal ranch/farm exempt under §4-185(b)).

permit.section: Plano City Code §4-185(c)-(e),(i)
permit.detail: Backyard hen permit compulsory before acquiring/keeping; application fee, site plan, coop details, approved training, owner notarized consent if tenant; annual validity and possible inspection. Does NOT waive building permit/HOA.

placement.detail: <5 hens enclosure >=20 ft from adjacent building not keeper-owned; >=5 hens enclosure >=50 ft; coop >=4 sq ft/hen, attached yard >=8 sq ft/hen; fenced 6-ft-height perimeter conditions and other accessory-structure rules.

max.section: Frisco Code §14-17(a)-(b)
max.detail: No more than twelve gallinaceous fowl in ONE enclosure; NOT proof of universal total flock maximum over all independently regulated enclosures.

roosters.section: Frisco Code §14-17(a)(1)
roosters.detail: Male gallinaceous fowl ordinarily prohibited; affirmative defense on premises >=1 acre. Doesn't waive nuisance or zoning.

placement.section: Frisco Code §§14-17(b), 14-18(a)-(b) (fowl enclosure and sanitation); compare §14-16(d) livestock-specific separation
placement.detail: Fowl confinement/enclosure must be kept sanitary and avoid nuisance, vectors and odor. §14-17 itself supplies no lot-line setback. The §14-16(d) 100-ft human-dwelling proximity test governs small/large LIVESTOCK and cannot automatically be applied to gallinaceous fowl.

max.section: Irving Code §6-62(a)(1)-(2)
max.detail: On <=1 acre: more than 25 chickens total (including rooster) prohibited, and at most one rooster if >=6 hens. >1 acre rooster/hen ratio addressed but no total flock max established by cited section.

roosters.section: Irving Code §6-62(a),(d)
roosters.detail: <=1 acre one rooster only with >=6 hens; >1 acre no more than one rooster per six hens. Special exhibition, government and research exceptions only if conditions met.

placement.detail: Coop >=25 ft from occupied/intended habitation structure on OTHER person's land, roofed >=1 sq ft roost space per chicken + outdoor >=10 sq ft per chicken; separate building/zoning standards apply.

max.section: §22.14 Fowl
max.detail: Four female fowl older than one month, combined domestic fowl

roosters.section: §22.14 Fowl
roosters.detail: Roosters and male peafowl prohibited

permit.detail: Zoning/building-permit coverage not resolved by reviewed city ordinance

placement.detail: 30 ft to other dwelling and 5 ft from adjacent residential-zoned property for pens/runs

max.section: McKinney Animal Control FAQ: Am I allowed to have chickens in city limits?
max.detail: Up to twelve hens in proper enclosure; FAQ does not establish a universal parcel building setback.

roosters.section: McKinney Animal Control FAQ: Am I allowed to have chickens in city limits?
roosters.detail: No roosters of any kind permitted by city animal guidance.

max.section: Denton City Animal Services FAQ: Can I keep chickens? / §6-26
max.detail: Up to eight hens per single residential neighborhood property; zoning and sanitation rules remain.

roosters.section: Denton City Animal Services FAQ: Can I keep chickens?
roosters.detail: Roosters prohibited on residential parcels smaller than one acre. Larger parcels not blanket approved: check ordinance/zoning.

placement.section: Denton City Animal Services FAQ: Can I keep chickens? / §6-26
placement.detail: Enclosures at least 150 ft from a residence, business/commercial office, school, hospital or nursing home, per official city FAQ; check exact reference geometry and city zoning.

roosters.section: NYC Health Code §161.19(a)
roosters.detail: Live roosters prohibited in New York City except specified authorized slaughterhouses or Health Code §161.01(a) exemptions; city's Urban Agriculture FAQ confirms ordinary backyard hens are permitted, roosters are not.

roosters.section: Backyard chickens and other fowl / Annual Fowl Permit Application Fees (updated 2026-07-06)
roosters.detail: City's official fee schedule lists a separate $110 rooster permit category. This does not guarantee permission at an address; neighbor consent, zoning approval, education and inspection remain required.

permit.section: Backyard chickens and other fowl / Application process (updated 2026-07-06)
permit.detail: Fowl permit MUST be approved before birds are bought; neighbor consent, approved course, zoning approval and animal-control inspection required; permit renewed annually. Building permissions separate.

max.section: City of Madison Chicken License: Regulations for Keeping Chickens, bullet 5
max.detail: Up to eight chickens as accessory use on lots containing up to four dwelling units and at qualified school, daycare or museum sites.

roosters.section: City of Madison Chicken License: Regulations for Keeping Chickens, bullet 2
roosters.detail: No roosters permitted.

permit.section: City of Madison Chicken License: registration, application and renewal sections
permit.detail: City chicken license required, apply within 30 days of acquisition, renew by Jan 1; Wisconsin DATCP livestock premises registration also required; zoning/building permits not automatically waived.

placement.section: City of Madison Chicken License: Regulations for Keeping Chickens, bullets 7-8
placement.detail: Chickens must stay within a covered or fenced enclosure; enclosure at least 25 ft from any residential structure on an adjacent lot (not measured from property boundary).

max.section: Indianapolis §743-306(W)(1)-(4), Table 743-306-3
max.detail: Eligible owner/resident of single-/two-family home may keep up to 12 combined adult chickens, quail, pigeons and ducks without personal livestock license; adult means 8+ months and counts combined, not by species.

roosters.section: Indianapolis §743-306(W)(5)
roosters.detail: One rooster per lot maximum; bird remains fully enclosed between dusk and dawn.

permit.section: Indianapolis §743-306(W)(3)-(4), Chapter 838
permit.detail: Personal livestock license not required for qualifying category-one poultry within standard cap; larger numbers or special lots require valid license; structure/building permits remain independent.

placement.detail: No front-yard coop, pen, roost, shelter or exercise area. Applicable zoning district setbacks, fencing and containment requirements apply; no single universal numeric setback is stated.

max.section: Raleigh Home Gardens guidance, updated 2026-07-13
